title: BEST APP FOR HABITS AND TASKS BUT I have a few feature suggestions that would really improve the app
body:
I would like tasks to support subtasks, so we can break down each task and add details underneath it.

2. It would be great to have file attachment support within tasks, so we can attach documents, images, or other files.

3. I’d also love the ability to link tasks with habits using tags, similar to the Daily Planner Brite app.

4. It would be very helpful to have a section at the top for tracking important recurring habits, so they are always visible and easy to follow.

5. I would really appreciate integration with Apple Reminders and Apple Calendar, so all tasks and schedules can be connected in one place.

6. It would be amazing to have a Mac version of the app, with strong sync across devices, because currently the sync is not working well for me and it’s frustrating.

Please if there any emails or way to contact with you to more suggestions in the future and look at this feedback I appreciate it your hard work ❤️❤️
author: Kazuha Heiji
